mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EMAIL_AUTH ( E_CODE, M_EMAIL, AUTH_CODE, E_EXPIRY, E_VERIFIED, E_DATE ) VALUES ( #{e_code}, #{m_email}, #{auth_num}, #{expire_date},'N', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT E_CODE, M_EMAIL, AUTH_CODE as auth_num, E_EXPIRY as expire_date, E_VERIFIED, E_DATE FROM EMAIL_AUTH WHERE M_EMAIL = #{m_email} ORDER BY E_DATE DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM EMAIL_AUTH WHERE E_EXPIRY < SYSDATE
